propositions: The snapshot janitor's reclaim trigger is an absolute 2 GiB free-space floor that becomes unreachable on small volumes: on a 30-GiB root it is crossed only at 93.3% used, above the 85% CloudWatch alarm threshold and the 90% peak actually reached.

The janitor correctly evicted nothing across the incident because both its eviction predicates were structurally unreachable: the absolute watermark never triggered, and the 7-day cold-trim exceeds the container's hourly lifetime.
A volume-relative headroom term added to the trigger (free_watermark_pct, defaulting to 0 for compatibility) allows the reclaim threshold to scale below the alarm floor on any volume size.
Hysteresis in the reclaim target (trigger + 5% margin) ensures a reclaim pass overshoots the threshold rather than re-firing every 300 seconds at the trigger boundary.
The fix restores the documented operational ordering (janitor reclaims, alarm is backstop) on small volumes without changing behavior on deployments that do not set the new knob.
